record.question: I get up before the sun rises.
record.explanation: Answer B: adverb clause. The underlined clause “before the sun rises” tells when the speaker gets up, so it is an adverb clause (B). Independent check: “Before the sun rises” is a subordinate time clause modifying “get up,” so it functions adverbially. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/clauses.
